questions.q:
우리말과 같은 뜻이 되도록 빈칸에 알맞은 말을 고르세요.
어젯밤에 지붕 위에 눈이 많이 있었다.
There ____ a lot of snow on the roof last night.
o: was
were
is
are
had
questions.e: snow는 셀 수 없는 명사라 양이 많아도 단수 취급해서 is/was를 쓰고, last night이 있으니 과거형 was예요. There 뒤에는 be동사만 써요.

questions.q:
대화의 빈칸에 알맞은 말을 고르세요.
A: ____ any good restaurants near the new shopping mall?
B: Yes, there are. There's a famous pizza place next to it.
o: Are there
Is there
There are
Do there
Are they
questions.e: There is/are의 의문문은 be동사를 There 앞으로 보내 Is/Are there ~?로 써요. restaurants가 복수라 Are there이고, 대답 there are와도 맞아요.

questions.q:
빈칸에 공통으로 알맞은 말을 고르세요.
There ____ a lot of information on this website about Korean history.
There ____ an old clock on the wall of my grandfather's room.
o: is
are
were
have
has
questions.e: information은 셀 수 없는 명사라 a lot of가 붙어도 is를 쓰고, an old clock은 단수라 is를 써요. There 뒤에 have/has는 쓰지 않아요.

questions.q:
다음 문장을 부정문으로 바르게 바꾼 것을 고르세요.
There were some children in the playground this morning.
o: There weren't any children in the playground this morning.
There weren't some children in the playground this morning.
There didn't be any children in the playground this morning.
There wasn't any children in the playground this morning.
There not were any children in the playground this morning.
questions.e: 부정문은 be동사 뒤에 not을 붙이고, some 대신 any를 써요. children이 복수라 weren't이고, didn't는 쓰지 않아요.

questions.q: 다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장을 고르세요.
o: There is some money in my coat pocket, so I can buy lunch.
There have many beautiful parks in this city.
Was there many students in the gym this morning?
There isn't some milk in the fridge, so let's buy some.
There are a new student in our class from Japan.
questions.e: money는 셀 수 없는 명사라 There is가 맞아요. There have → There are, Was there many students → Were there many students, isn't some → isn't any, There are a new student → There is a new student로 고쳐야 해요.

questions.q:
대화의 빈칸에 알맞은 말을 고르세요.
A: Was there a post office near your old house?
B: ____ I had to walk for thirty minutes to send a letter.
o: No, there wasn't.
No, there weren't.
No, it wasn't.
No, there isn't.
No, there didn't.
questions.e: Was there ~?로 물으면 Yes, there was. / No, there wasn't.로 대답해요. 단수 a post office라 wasn't이고, 과거로 물었으니 isn't는 쓸 수 없어요.

questions.q: 다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장을 고르세요.
o: There was many cars on the road because of the heavy rain.
There is a big park between the school and the library.
There weren't any empty seats on the bus this morning.
Is there a swimming pool in your new apartment building?
There is a lot of sugar in this orange juice, so don't drink too much.
questions.e: 뒤에 오는 명사 many cars가 복수라서 과거형도 were를 써요. → There were many cars on the road because of the heavy rain.

questions.q: 다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장을 고르세요.
o: There are some water in the bottle, so you can drink it.
There are three new students in our class this year.
Were there many people at the museum last weekend?
There wasn't any food in the fridge, so we ordered pizza.
There is an old church at the end of this street.
questions.e: water는 셀 수 없는 명사라서 some이 붙어도 is를 써요. → There is some water in the bottle, so you can drink it.

questions.q: 다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장을 고르세요.
o: There is some eggs in the basket, but there isn't any milk.
There aren't any buses to the airport after midnight.
Is there any homework for tomorrow's math class?
There was a small cafe here, but now there is a bank.
There are twenty-five students in Minho's class.
questions.e: be동사는 뒤에 오는 진짜 주어에 맞춰요. some eggs는 복수라 are를 써야 해요. → There are some eggs in the basket, but there isn't any milk.

questions.q:
다음 문장을 의문문으로 바꿀 때 빈칸에 알맞은 말을 쓰세요. (세 단어)
There was some soup in the pot on the stove.
→ ____ soup in the pot on the stove?
questions.ko: 가스레인지 위의 냄비에 수프가 조금 있었니?
questions.e: 의문문은 be동사를 There 앞으로 보내 Was there ~?로 쓰고, 의문문에서는 some 대신 any를 써요.

questions.q:
괄호 안의 말을 알맞은 현재형으로 바꿔 빈칸에 쓰세요.
There ____ not much time before the last train leaves, so hurry up. (be)
questions.ko: 마지막 기차가 떠나기 전까지 시간이 많지 않으니 서둘러.
questions.e: time은 셀 수 없는 명사라서 There is를 쓰고, 부정은 is 뒤에 not을 붙여요.

questions.q:
우리말과 같은 뜻이 되도록 빈칸에 알맞은 말을 쓰세요. (세 단어)
지난주에는 이 근처에 꽃집이 하나도 없었다.
____ flower shops near here last week.
questions.ko: 지난주에는 이 근처에 꽃집이 하나도 없었다.
questions.e: flower shops가 복수이고 last week이 있으니 과거형 were를 쓰고, 부정문은 not (+ any)를 붙여 There weren't any ~로 써요.

questions.q: There is a lot of interesting books in the school library.
questions.ko: 학교 도서관에는 흥미로운 책이 많이 있다.
questions.e: be동사는 There 뒤에 오는 진짜 주어에 맞춰요. a lot of 뒤의 books가 복수라서 are를 써요. is → are

questions.q: Were there a big tree in front of your house ten years ago?
questions.ko: 10년 전에 너희 집 앞에 큰 나무가 한 그루 있었니?
questions.e: 의문문에서도 be동사는 뒤의 명사에 맞춰요. a big tree는 단수라서 과거형 Was를 써요. Were → Was

questions.q: There isn't some information about the festival on the website.
questions.ko: 웹사이트에 그 축제에 관한 정보가 하나도 없다.
questions.e: 부정문에서는 some 대신 any를 써요. information은 셀 수 없는 명사라 isn't는 맞아요. some → any

questions.ko: 지난 토요일 밤에 그 콘서트에 사람들이 많이 있었니?
ans: Were there many people at the concert last Saturday night?
questions.e: 과거 의문문은 Were there + 복수명사 ~? 순서로 쓰고, 장소와 때를 뒤에 이어요.

questions.ko: 이 병에는 주스가 많이 있지만, 유리잔에는 하나도 없다.
questions.cond: 주어진 말을 이용하고, 필요하면 단어를 더하거나 형태를 바꾸세요.
ans: There is a lot of juice in this bottle, but there isn't any in the glass.
There is a lot of juice in this bottle, but there is not any in the glass.
There's a lot of juice in this bottle, but there isn't any in the glass.
There's a lot of juice in this bottle, but there is not any in the glass.
questions.e: juice는 셀 수 없는 명사라 a lot of가 붙어도 There is로 쓰고, 부정은 there isn't any로 써요. 두 문장은 but으로 이어요.

questions.ko: 우리 교실에는 컴퓨터가 한 대도 없었지만, 지금은 두 대가 있다.
questions.cond: 주어진 말을 이용하고, 필요하면 단어를 더하거나 형태를 바꾸세요.
ans: There weren't any computers in our classroom, but now there are two.
There were not any computers in our classroom, but now there are two.
There weren't any computers in our classroom, but there are two now.
There were not any computers in our classroom, but there are two now.
questions.e: computers가 복수라 과거 부정은 There weren't any ~로 쓰고, 지금은 현재형 there are two로 써요.
